items.title: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
items.summary: Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance. The article Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Reflection 發布了其首款開放權重模型 Beam。這套混合專家系統在每個 token 中僅啟動 501 億個參數中的 23 億個，旨在以少三到四倍的運算量，在編碼和推理能力上媲美 GLM 5.2。其針對 Deepseek 和 Qwen 等中國開放權重競爭對手的策略是效率優先於原始效能。本文「Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: Researchers at PhAI Labs have expanded Yann LeCun's JEPA architecture to work across seven fields, from robotics to biomedicine. items.title: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告
items.summary: OpenAI宣佈將擴大ChatGPT廣告測試，10月稍晚將在美國的圖片生成功能中測試新的視覺廣告，以圖片呈現商品或服務，並與使用者生成的圖片分開顯示。OpenAI也擴充廣告成效追蹤及投放安全機制，讓廣告主瞭解廣告是否帶來購買等後續行動，同時避免廣告出現在敏感或不適合的對話旁。 新的視覺廣告會在使用者生成圖片時出現，可使用商品照片、使用情境或服務相關圖片呈現，並會明確標示為廣告，不會混入使用者要求ChatGPT生成的圖片。首波測試僅限美國及部分廣告主，OpenAI表示，廣告也不會影響ChatGPT產生的回答。

items.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
items.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 77 percent of Americans want to slow down or stop AI development until its safety has been verified. 86 percent support independent safety standards, and 74 percent have little or no trust in AI company leaders. "[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal. The article Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據昆尼皮亞克大學（Quinnipiac University）的一項民調顯示，77% 的美國人希望放慢或停止人工智慧發展，直到其安全性得到驗證。86% 的人支持獨立的安全標準，74% 的人對人工智慧公司領導者幾乎沒有或完全沒有信任。「……大眾希望有的防護措施，不只是單純相信公司領導者的一面之詞，」研究人員切坦·賈斯瓦（Chetan Jaiswal）表示。《大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止，新民調顯示》（Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds）一文最早出現於 The Decoder。

items.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
items.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

One install command sets it up, and an Auto router picks a model for each session. Together claims savings of over 50%. items.title: Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads
items.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.summary: Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance. The article Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items_ai.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。
